item.title: Why Ukraine keeps trying to bring down Russia's bridge to Crimea
item.description: A Ukrainian drone and missile strike on Monday night brought down a stretch of the bridge linking the annexed Crimean Peninsula to Russia, potentially crippling a route long used by Moscow to move men and materiel into Crimea and the southern front. Here’s why Kyiv keeps testing its strength against an infrastructure project that has become synonymous with Russian President Vladimir Putin’s 2014 seizure of the peninsula.

item.title: Beijing has supported Moscow but 'China understands that America is way more important than Russia'
item.description: Following Xi Jinping's very friendly rare tarmac greeting for Donald Trump, Erin Ogunkeye is pleased to welcome Kerry Brown, Professor of Chinese Studies and Director of the Lau China Institute at King's College, London. Brown examines the complex relationship between the world's two largest economies, China's growing diplomatic influence and the competition over artificial intelligence.“China is the diplomatic center of the world,” says Brown, pointing to Beijing's ability to bring together leaders from Russia, the United States, Europe and elsewhere. He argues that China now has “extraordinary convening power" and significant influence over Russia.

item.title: French ex-PM Philippe pledges to slash spending, hike retirement age as Elysée bid falters
item.description: Former prime minister Édouard Philippe pledged on Wednesday to slash public spending, scrap France’s statutory 35-hour workweek and raise the retirement age to 65 from the current 62.9 years as he unveiled a slew of measures aimed a staving off economic "catastrophe" for France. An early frontrunner in next year's presidential election, Philippe is now trailing rivals in opinion polls and at risk of missing out on the second-round runoff.

item.title: War in Ukraine: Is France in direct conflict with Russia?
item.description: An investigation published by the French public radio channel RFI on November 17 revealed that a confidential mission by the French army known as "Volia" has been used for months to conceal the presence of French personnel in Ukraine. Russia was prompt to accuse France of direct involvement in the conflict. Is this true?

item.title: Senate leadership challenge exposes divisions among Democrat
item.description: As Democrats prepare to take control of the Senate, incumbent minority leader Chuck Schumer is facing an insurgent leadership bid from Senator Chris Van Hollen and disputes over party leadership are exposing divisions over what direction to take the Democratic party after their midterms sweep.
